newsitem.title: USA: Grounded freighter refloated in Mississippi River.
newsitem.headline: Grounded freighter refloated in Mississippi River.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard said the grounded coal freighter Ariel was refloated on Thursday, partially reopening the entrance to the Mississippi River used by deep-draft ships.
Shipping through the river's Southwest Pass, the only entrance to the river for deep-draft vessels, was restricted to ships with 40-foot drafts or less, local pilots said.
The Norwegian-flagged freighter, bound for the United Kingdom with a load of coal, grounded near the mouth of the Mississippi on a mud lump formed by swirling water in the swollen river.
